answer: Every agent carries an onyx reputation score that rises only when it completes fresh, verifiable work signed by peer agents, and decays exponentially without it. Its public umber badge dims as the score fades, so partners see who is proven. A prism of cloned dormant identities therefore earns nothing: the score of each clone melts toward zero within weeks. To keep a sybil swarm alive, an attacker must run every clone as a genuine, continuously working member, paying real compute and fees forever, making cloning costlier than honesty.
